evidence.description: Frontend build tooling and development server
evidence.releaseNotes:
### Features

* **build:** avoid settling seen preload dependencies for performance ([#23446](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23446)) ([e6f6b3e](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/e6f6b3e3119256daa837b2dc399058c8aa45b470))

### Bug Fixes

* handle CRLF line endings in code frame positions ([#23219](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23219)) ([9913672](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/9913672bee9c34a2df7fff4c2538783cd4f43b4e))
* only treat whole `node_modules` path segments as dependencies (fix [#17467](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/17467)) ([#23437](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23437)) ([ef0dc17](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/ef0dc17ada53d1169ae5a89cb8f6482831466755))

### Performance Improvements

* **proxy:** pre-compile context matchers at server creation ([#23263](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23263)) ([8abf700](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8abf700eeb2411d8402d08f8e2696effafdbe774))
highlights: The build process avoids settling seen preload dependencies for performance.
CRLF line endings are correctly handled in code frame positions.
Only whole node_modules path segments are treated as dependencies.
Proxy context matchers are pre-compiled at server creation.

drafts.title: Show HN: vite – Frontend build tooling and development server
drafts.body:
vite v8.3.0 includes updates to the build process, development server, and path handling.

The build process now avoids settling seen preload dependencies for performance. Proxy context matchers are pre-compiled at server creation, and only whole node_modules path segments are treated as dependencies. Additionally, code frame positions correctly handle CRLF line endings.

How do you currently handle preload dependency resolution in your build setups?

vitejs/vite v8.3.0 변경 사항입니다.

### 변경 내용
- 빌드 과정에서 이미 확인한 preload 종속성 처리를 건너뜁니다.
- 코드 프레임 위치 계산 시 CRLF 줄바꿈을 정상적으로 처리합니다.
- 전체 node_modules 경로 세그먼트만 의존성으로 처리합니다.
- 서버 생성 시점에 프록시 컨텍스트 매처를 미리 컴파일합니다.
